statement: Let Open be the least subset of {0,...,n-1} such that for every i with 0 <= i < n, if (i occurs in initialBoxes or i occurs in containedBoxes[j] for some j in Open) and (status[i] = 1 or i occurs in keys[j] for some j in Open), then i is in Open.
